question: Which of the following is characterized as cold air?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** 

__
 
• The natural motion of air, due to a current in a particular direction is called wind.

There are mainly three types of winds:

 
• **Permanent Winds**____ -__ They blow constantly throughout the year in a particular direction. They are trade winds known as westerlies and easterlies. 
 
• __**Seasonal Winds** - __This kind of winds change their direction in different seasons.
 
• __**Local winds-** __These winds blow in a small area during a particular period of day or year.Winds like Loo, Mistral, Foehn, Bora.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Mistral** is the most common local **cold wind**.
 
• They **originate** on the **Alps** and move over France towards the **Mediterranean Sea** through the **Rhine valley.**
 
• They are very **cold, dry, and high-velocity** winds.
 
• They bring **down the temperature** below **freezing point** in areas of their influence.
 
• People in these areas protect their **orchards and gardens** growing **thick hedges** and building their houses facing the Mediterranean sea. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sirocco**-a **hot wind**, often dusty or rainy, blowing from North Africa across the Mediterranean to southern Europe.
 
• Zonda is a **warm dry wind** blowing down the side of a mountain in Argentina, where it blows from the west across the Andes Mountains.
 
• **Harmattan**-a **very dry, dusty** easterly or north-easterly wind on the West African coast, occurring from December to February.

***Hence, Mistral is characterized as cold air.***
